title: Extract fieldwork::profile module
description:
HTML profile page rendering for ActivityPub actors. ~160 lines duplicated in server.rs across all three projects.

Source: BS server.rs:1317-1476 (serve_profile_html), SH/GJ activitypub.rs (similar).

Public API:
- ProfileData struct { display_name, username, domain, bio_html, avatar_url, header_url, created_at, post_count, following_count, followers_count, metadata_fields: Vec<(String, String)>, recent_posts: Vec<ProfilePost> }
- ProfilePost struct { id, content_html, published, url }
- render_profile_html(profile: &ProfileData, theme_css: &str) -> String — render full HTML page with:
  - Content negotiation alternate link (application/activity+json)
  - Mastodon-style metadata table with links
  - Recent posts list with dates
  - Theme CSS injection point
  - PAGE_CSS constant (shared base stylesheet)

What stays in consumers: DB queries to populate ProfileData, route registration, content negotiation logic.

Deps: None beyond std (pure string templating). Optional: fieldwork::sanitize for bio HTML.

Note: PAGE_CSS constant is identical across all three. Metadata fields use Mastodon PropertyValue convention. Posts are rendered as simple HTML — no JS framework.
close_reason: All 3 final extractions done. relay (10 tests), actor_cache (9 tests), profile (6 tests). 177 total fieldwork tests pass.
